units.source_text: 然而，这小小的神社如今依然如故。

en.t: Yet this tiny shrine remains just as it was even today.

units.source_text: 在《源氏物语》中亦有所提及。

en.t: It is also mentioned in The Tale of Genji.

units.source_text: 据说这里是神社的遗址，

en.t: It is said that this is the site of the shrine,

units.source_text: 当年侍奉伊势神宫的斋宫（内亲王）曾在这里闲居三年，

en.t: where the Saiō, an imperial princess who once served at Ise Shrine, lived quietly for three years,
cultivating herself, purifying her conduct, fasting, and bathing in ritual cleansing.

units.source_text: 它以带有原树皮的黑木建造的牌坊和小篱墙而闻名。

en.t: It is known for its torii gate and small fence made of dark unstripped wood with the original bark still attached.
